cache.description: Cache policy, if this node's result may be served from a cache.

on_error.description:
Typed error handler, if a failure should be compensated instead of
failing the run.

retry.description: Retry policy, if this node retries a failed attempt.

timeout.description: Timeout policy, if this node is time-bounded.

oneOf.description: The engine's own default key composition.
Key on only these declared fields' values.

fields.description: The field names to key on.

key.description: How the cache key is composed.

ttl_secs.description: How long a cached result stays valid, in seconds.

oneOf.description: Always traverse this edge.
Traverse if the output contains this string.
Traverse if the output matches this regex.

Traverse according to a registered evaluator named here; an
unregistered name is [`CompileError::UnregisteredEdgeEvaluator`].

condition.description: The edge's traversal condition; `None` behaves like `Always`.

oneOf.description: Route the error to another node.

error_field.description: The field the error is written into.

oneOf.description: Absorb the error by merging a fallback delta.

fallback_delta.description:
The delta merged in place of the failed node's own delta,
keyed by field name.

oneOf.description:
Handle according to a registered handler named here; an
unregistered name is [`CompileError::UnregisteredErrorHandler`].

FieldDoc.description: One field of a [`WarGraphDoc`]'s Battlefield schema.

default.description: Default value used when the field is absent.

kind.description:
The field's expected JSON value shape -- informational only this
phase: `compile` does not cross-check it against `reducer` or
`default`.

reducer.description: The merge strategy applied to deltas targeting this field.

required.description:
Whether the engine must refuse to start a run that cannot resolve
this field.

FieldKindDoc.description:
The declared JSON value shape of a [`FieldDoc`] -- documentation only
(see [`FieldDoc::kind`]'s own rustdoc).

oneOf.description: A JSON string.
A JSON number.
A JSON boolean.
A JSON array.
A JSON object.
Any JSON value.

GateNodeDoc.description: A `kind: "gate"` node's document form, compiling to [`NodeSpec::Gate`].

expires_in_secs.description: How long after raising this request expires, if ever.

on_expire.description: What happens if this request expires unanswered.

output_field.description:
The field the delivered value is written to; required for every
[`ParleyKindDoc`] except `StateEdit`, which must leave this `None`
(`WarGraph::validate` enforces the pairing, D-05).

parley.description: The shape of input this Gate awaits.

payload_template.description:
Renders the raised request's payload from the Battlefield, if
declared.

prompt_template.description: Renders the raised request's prompt from the Battlefield.

LimitsDoc.description:
Mirrors [`EngineLimits`]. Every field falls back to
[`EngineLimits::default`]'s value when absent, via this type's own
`Default` impl and `#[serde(default)]` on [`WarGraphDoc::limits`].

max_muster_tasks.description: Maximum number of tasks a single Muster directive may request.

max_node_visits.description: Maximum number of times any single node may execute within one run.

max_supersteps.description: Maximum number of supersteps before the run fails.

run_timeout_secs.description: Optional wall-clock budget for the whole run, in seconds.

NodeDoc.description:
One node in a [`WarGraphDoc`] (D-33). `kind` names which of `paladin`,
`gate`, or `workflow` is populated; deliberately NOT a
`#[serde(tag = "kind")]`-dispatched enum sharing the `kind` key, because
that combination cannot both (a) accept and round-trip an unrecognised
`kind` string for [`CompileError::UnsupportedNodeKind`] to report, and
(b) combine with `#[serde(flatten)]` and `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]`
on the SAME struct (a serde restriction, not a choice) -- so this shape
keeps `kind` as its own always-present field and gates on it explicitly
in [`NodeDoc::kind_doc`], the one place a `"function"` (or any other
unrecognised) kind is turned into a typed, string-preserving error
rather than a raw `serde_json` deserialize failure.

aegis.description: This node's own `Aegis` override, if any.

defer.description: Whether this node is registered deferred (`WarGraph::add_deferred_node`).

id.description: This node's id, unique within the document.

kind.description:
Which of `paladin` / `gate` / `workflow` this node is; any other
value fails [`WarGraphDoc::compile`] with
[`CompileError::UnsupportedNodeKind`].

oneOf.description: Fail the run with a structured reason naming the parley (default).
Substitute this value as the response.

PaladinNodeDoc.description:
A `kind: "paladin"` node's document form, compiling to
[`NodeSpec::Paladin`].

input_template.description: Renders the Paladin's string input from the Battlefield.

max_loops.description:
Maximum reasoning loops (`MaxLoops::Fixed`); defaults to `3` when
absent.

output_field.description: The field this node's output is written to.

output_schema.description:
When `Some`, this node dispatches through the structured executor
and the parsed JSON value is written to `output_field` (RT-05).

stop_words.description: Tokens that signal the Paladin should stop.

temperature.description:
Response randomness; defaults to `0.7` when absent. `f64` rather
than `PaladinData.temperature`'s own `f32` (cast down in `compile`):
a JSON literal like `0.7` round-trips exactly through `serde_json`'s
`f64`-only number representation, but the SAME literal narrowed to
`f32` first and then widened back for serialisation prints as
`0.699999988079071` -- breaking the fixture corpus's byte-for-byte
round-trip guarantee for no benefit (the narrowing to `PaladinData`'s
`f32` still happens, just once, at `compile` time).

oneOf.description: A yes/no decision.
A choice among `choices`.
Free-form text input.
A structured state edit.

ReducerDoc.description:
Mirrors [`DispatchRule`] -- excludes `DispatchRule::Custom`: a document
has no way to name a `Battlefield`-level custom dispatch resolver
(`WarGraphDoc::compile` always validates against an empty
`CustomDispatchResolver`), so declaring one here would always fail
`WarGraph::validate` and never resolve.

oneOf.description: Last write wins.
Value must be a JSON array; deltas append.
Value must be a JSON object; deltas shallow-merge keys.
Numeric accumulation.

RetryPolicyDoc.description:
Mirrors [`RetryPolicy`]. Every field falls back to
[`RetryPolicy::default`]'s value when absent (the same defaults, via
`#[serde(default)]` at the container level backed by this type's own
`Default` impl below).

backoff_factor.description: The multiplier applied per additional attempt.

initial_interval_ms.description: The delay, in milliseconds, before attempt 2.

jitter.description: Whether to add random jitter to the computed delay.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts, including the first. `0` is invalid.

max_interval_ms.description: The ceiling every computed delay is capped at, in milliseconds.

retry_on.description: Which classified errors this policy retries.

oneOf.description: Retry only transient errors (the default).
Retry transient and unknown errors.

Retry according to a registered predicate evaluator named here; an
unregistered name is [`CompileError::UnregisteredRetryPredicate`].

SchemaRefDoc.description:
A reference to a JSON Schema, either carried inline or resolved by name
through [`EngineRegistries::output_schemas`]. Mirrors
[`SchemaRef`].

oneOf.description: A JSON Schema value carried inline.

The name of a schema registered elsewhere; an unregistered name is
[`CompileError::UnregisteredOutputSchema`].

StateMapDoc.description:
Mirrors [`crate::engine::graph::StateMap`]: `(parent, child)` input pairs
and `(child, parent)` output pairs.

TimeoutPolicyDoc.description:
Mirrors [`TimeoutPolicy`], in whole seconds (sub-second per-attempt
timeouts are not a documented use case this phase).

idle_timeout_secs.description: The longest an attempt may go without progress, in seconds.

run_timeout_secs.description: A hard wall-clock cap on each attempt, in seconds.

WorkflowNodeDoc.description:
A `kind: "workflow"` node's document form, compiling recursively to
[`NodeSpec::Battalion`].

graph.description:
The nested document, compiled with the SAME [`EngineRegistries`]
bundle the parent uses (Phase 23 D-21).

restart_on_resume.description: Whether a resumed run restarts this child from scratch.

description:
The serde/schemars document form of a [`WarGraph`] (D-33, D-34): every
field here is either a plain, `schemars`-describable scalar or another
doc type in this module -- never a `NodeSpec`, `Aegis`, or other
`paladin-core`/`paladin-battalion` runtime type directly, so this type
alone carries the `JsonSchema` derive `paladin-core` may not take
(ADR-0015).

edges.description: Every static edge this graph declares.

limits.description:
Run bounds; absent fields fall back to [`EngineLimits::default`]'s
values via [`LimitsDoc::default`].

nodes.description:
Every node this graph declares, in document order (compiled
deterministically in this same order).
